description: One company in one call, from its domain: registrar, DNS and email provider, the website's tech stack, and hiring from its own job board (open roles by department and place, salary ranges, roles opened or closed lately). Add name and country for the official register entry, or ticker for SEC figures. Each part links to its source; a part with nothing to report says why.

country.description: Register for the name: gb, no, fr, fi, cz, sk, ie, au, or global (LEI). Needs name.

domain.description: The company's website domain, URL or an email address at it.

name.description: Company name. Improves the hiring match, and with country adds the official register entry.

ticker.description: Stock ticker or SEC CIK, to add reported revenue from SEC filings.

name: company_lookup
title: Everything public about a company
